ARCHITECTURE MAP

MODULES (outermost layer first)

  entrypoint       api
  adapter          stripe
  application      orders
  domain           billing
  (no layer)       audit

SEAMS (6)

  accepted   api -> billing  (functional)
  allowed    api -> stripe  (functional)
  violation  billing -> stripe  (functional)
  observed   orders -> audit  (functional)
  allowed    orders -> billing  (functional)
  allowed    stripe -> orders  (unknown)
